description: Read the editorial profile and twelve estimated axis positions for a country, person, ideology or party, by catalogue id, full name or known alias in any supported language. Include result_url to get the user’s compatibility and signed differences on every axis using the website formula. For partial names or misspellings, use axes_search_profiles first.

result_url.description: An actual compatible 12 Axes result link from any domain, a relative path, or its query parameters. Requires v with twelve scores or est/rep/pod/imi/dip/int/eco/con/com/rel/mor/tec. A homepage, image filename or placeholder is not a result. Only encoded data is read.

name: axes_lookup_profile
title: Look up a 12 Axes catalogue profile
